row.proto: void *Ne_FileSystem_FindDeviceForPath(void *fs, void *parentDev, void *arg3, void *pathBuf, uint8_t flag, char wantKind)
row.notes: After 0x143f43e50 normalises the path, walks device list (fs+0xf8 or parent+0x140, next at +0x140) and returns the first device whose prefix string (+0x18) matches the start of pathBuf (+0x10) and whose vtbl +0xb0/+0xa8 kind check passes; strips the prefix in place. Sets errno 0x22 if prefix longer than path; on no match clears pathBuf to inline storage and returns 0. Good hook to observe path to mount resolution.
